how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-uldaman-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:17:obj:0: Bring 12 Magenta Fungus Caps to Ghak Healtouch in Thelsamar.
rows.quest:17:details:0: I've heard about a newly discovered plant called the magenta fungus caps. They grow in clusters at the Uldaman dig site and can be found in the early tunnels and deep within the less-explored areas. I want to study their potential use in alchemy, and that's where you come in.
rows.quest:17:details:1: BFind the magenta cap clusters and bring me a dozen caps. Be warned, the clusters may spew out poison spores if jostled.
rows.quest:17:details:2: BDo this for me, and I'll whip up a batch of one of my famous restorative elixirs for you!
rows.quest:17:completion:0: Well done ⟦1⟧, you've proven your worth once again! The caps will be an interesting study, yon verily!
rows.quest:17:completion:1: BAnd now, as promised, enjoy a taste of one of my more potent restorative brews from my personal stock...
rows.quest:17:completion:2: BIf you are a skilled alchemist, then perhaps we might have some additional business to conduct. Regardless, I thank you for your assistance!
rows.quest:704:obj:0: Bring 4 Carved Stone Urns to Prospector ⟦E1⟧ in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:704:details:0: The last report I received from Agmond is troubling, more so now that he's dead! He mentioned that his diggers uncovered "ancient urns" at the dig site outside Uldaman. I fear that the urns he found at that site incited the troggs, just as did the idols I found here.
rows.quest:704:details:1: BI need you to get those urns for our studies. Go to the Uldaman site, gather the urns, then return to me.
rows.quest:704:completion:0: Well done! With luck and diligence, we will find whatever link exists between the troggs and these ancient artifacts.
rows.quest:704:completion:1: BYou have done a great deed for the Prospectors, ⟦2⟧. Your efforts will not be forgotten. And neither will Agmond.
rows.quest:709:obj:0: Bring the Tablet of Ryun'eh to Theldurin the Lost.
rows.quest:709:details:0: Oh my! Oh my! There is a doom approaching. Mark me! A doom!
rows.quest:709:details:1: BNo, I cannot speak of it...cannot utter their names or they may hear me! But if we learn, yes, if we learn more of them...then maybe we can learn how to foil them!
rows.quest:709:details:3: BGo into Uldaman. No! I said it! You must find...find the tablet of...Ryun'eh. Yes, find it! And don't make me speak that name again!
rows.quest:709:details:4: BIt is deep in that place, in an ancient chest. That's where it hides...in a chest crafted before the works of any dwarf.
rows.quest:709:completion:0: Oh, fortune is with us! Thank you! We may yet be saved!
rows.quest:721:details:0: ⟦3⟧, can ye find him? Can you find Hammertoe in Uldaman?
rows.quest:721:details:1: BIf those dirty Shadowforge are holdin' him hostage to figure out what he knows about the titan excavations, then all of ⟦E3⟧ could be in huge trouble.
rows.quest:721:details:2: BFor a long time now those Dark Irons have been lookin' for magics to make more powerful golems. Hammertoe was doin' the same, of course, but only to stop them.
rows.quest:721:details:3: BThey're probably keepin' him alive until they learn what he knows.Ye've got to hurry if you're gonna save him!
rows.quest:721:completion:0: Yes? Ah'm sorry... ⟦4⟧ Feel so weak. Can ye come closer, ⟦5⟧?
rows.quest:721:completion:1: BRyedol sent ye? Muradin be praised, that boy's not as slow in the head as I once thought. ⟦6⟧
rows.quest:722:obj:0: Find Hammertoe's Amulet and return it to him in Uldaman.
rows.quest:722:details:0: Ye're brave... ⟦7⟧... to come into Uldaman fer me, ⟦8⟧.
rows.quest:722:details:1: BIf ye're really here to help... ol' Hammertoe, then... ⟦9⟧... you'll need to find... me amulet.
rows.quest:722:details:2: BDeepshadow's got it... Magregan Deepshadow. He's 'round here... in the ruins fer sure. That amulet'll lead 'em... ⟦10⟧... right to the scrolls if he ain't stopped. It's up to you, ⟦11⟧. Please... get that amulet.
rows.quest:722:details:3: BThe scrolls will surely help the Dark Irons create even more powerful golems. I just know it. I can feel it in me bones.
rows.quest:722:completion:1: BAh knew you'd find me amulet, ⟦13⟧.
rows.quest:1139:obj:0: Find the Tablet of Will, and return them to Advisor Belgrum in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:1139:details:0: We've slowed the Shadowforge clan by cutting them off from Blackrock Spire, but Hammertoe's quest is still unfulfilled. His death must not be in vain. He dreamt of finding the Tablet of Will: a stone shard inscribed with magic by the titans themselves to help imbue their creations with life--making them have a will of their own, or so the legends say.
rows.quest:1139:details:1: BWe must still recover the Tablet before the Shadowforge clan finds it.
rows.quest:1139:details:2: BReturn to Uldaman, find the tablet, and return here immediately.
rows.quest:1139:completion:0: <Advisor Belgrum shakes his head in disbelief as you hand him the stone shard.>
rows.quest:1139:completion:1: B⟦17⟧, this is amazing. I shall have this brought to the king's mages as soon as possible. They will want to study it to find out if the legends are true. But that is a discussion for another time: you have aided our people more than I would have ever expected--thank you.
rows.quest:1360:obj:0: Get Krom Stoutarm's treasured possession from his chest in the North Common Hall of Uldaman, and bring it to him in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:1360:details:0: I had myself a fine job as a digger at the Uldaman excavation site in the ⟦E4⟧... that is until those blasted troggs showed up. I escaped with my hide barely intact, and nothing else. In the chaos, I left my most treasured possession. It's safe from the troggs in my chest, sure, but it's right in the thick of 'em.
rows.quest:1360:details:1: BI'd be in your debt, both in honor and coin, if you could fetch it for me! A chest with my name on it is at the end of the North Common Hall. That's the one you need to get in.
rows.quest:1360:completion:0: Ah, I feel complete again - thank you kindly.
rows.quest:1360:completion:1: BSome dwarves may treasure the luster of metal, and some may treasure the glint of gems... but a Stoutarm without a treasured stein in hand is hardly a Stoutarm at all!
rows.quest:2198:obj:0: Search for the original creator of the shattered necklace to learn of its potential value.
rows.quest:2198:details:0: You have found a tarnished necklace, though the tarnish belies intricate and magical craftsmanship. The necklace has been shattered, as its setting appears to be missing three gems. On the underside of the necklace is the faint imprint of the city seal for ⟦E3⟧. Below the seal are three tiny, engraved letters: "TdK".
rows.quest:2198:details:1: BIf there is anything to be gleaned from the necklace, you will need to learn about its origins. Perhaps the seal and the initials are a start...
rows.quest:2198:completion:0: Yes... I am the jeweler who made this necklace. I also am not in the business of handing out information as though it were free. Information is never free, friend. If I am going to help you out, you need to help ME out first.
rows.quest:2199:obj:0: Bring five silver bars to Talvash del Kissel in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:2199:details:0: I am a jeweler of great renown here in ⟦E3⟧! Well, former renown anyway... I have fallen onto hard times due to the chicanery of a competitor! A bad reputation in this business spells financial disaster. As a result, I find myself without a copper to my good-though-currently-sullied name.
rows.quest:2199:details:1: BI want you to get me five silver bars to finish an order I received - the first in what seems like an eternity.
rows.quest:2199:details:2: BYou get me those five silver bars, and I'll answer your questions on the necklace.
rows.quest:2199:completion:0: You're all right in my book; I don't care what everyone else has been saying... I kid, I kid! Seriously, thank you my friend.
rows.quest:2199:completion:1: BNow, the necklace you have is one of my finest creations, but it is missing three gems that help bind magic power to it. I crafted it for a paladin some time ago. He was on a self-appointed quest to clear out the "evil taint" present at an excavation site in the ⟦E4⟧ called Uldaman.
rows.quest:2199:completion:2: BWell... that paladin died in Uldaman, and that was just the beginning of my woes.
rows.quest:2200:obj:0: Search for clues as to the current disposition of Talvash's necklace within Uldaman. The slain paladin he mentioned was the person who had it last.
rows.quest:2200:details:0: A competitor of mine started a rumor that my necklace cursed the paladin. Needless to say, no one wants to buy cursed items from a jeweler.
rows.quest:2200:details:1: B⟦18⟧, I'll make you a deal - find the gems and I'll reassemble the necklace, so long as you'll advertise that I do NOT make cursed items!
rows.quest:2200:details:2: BTry looking for clues in Uldaman; maybe see if the paladin's body is down there, since he's the one who we know had it last! When you find the gems you should use this; it'll allow you to contact me here in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:2200:completion:0: Remains of a paladin: Reading the journal reveals that after much effort, the paladin had identified the location of all three missing gems:
rows.quest:2200:completion:1: BThe Shadowforge dwarves hid the ruby in their barricaded area as they battled the Troggs for control of Uldaman.
rows.quest:2200:completion:2: BThe troggs stashed the topaz in an urn located near some unusual inhabitants of Uldaman - ⟦E5⟧ dwarves!
rows.quest:2200:completion:3: BFinally, the trogg elder himself took the sapphire as his own.
rows.quest:2201:obj:0: Find the ruby, sapphire, and topaz that are scattered throughout Uldaman. Once acquired, contact Talvash del Kissel remotely by using the Phial of Scrying he previously gave you.
rows.quest:2201:obj:1: BFrom the journal, you know...⟦19⟧* The ruby has been stashed in a barricaded Shadowforge area.⟦20⟧* The topaz has been hidden in an urn in one of the Trogg areas, near some ⟦E5⟧ dwarves.
rows.quest:2201:obj:2: B* The sapphire has been claimed by Grimlok, the trogg leader.
rows.quest:2201:details:0: The paladin's journal has provided perhaps the only clues that Uldaman will yield as to the location of the necklace's gems. If the paladin's scribing remains accurate, then the Shadowforge dwarves and the troggs that vie for control of the dig site will need to be dealt with.
rows.quest:2201:details:1: BArmed with this knowledge, the search for the gems begins in earnest. When all the gems have been acquired, Talvash in ⟦E3⟧ should be notified via the Phial of Scrying as per his instructions.
rows.quest:2201:completion:0: Yep, those indeed are the three gems. Good job! Unfortunately, your work isn't quite over just yet.
rows.quest:2201:completion:1: BNo, I'm not trying to pull a fast one here, silly ⟦21⟧. This is about making magic jewelry - Talvash del Kissel quality-level jewelry! You need a strong power source to give it some oomph. Well, that necklace has no more oomph to give.
rows.quest:2202:obj:0: Bring 12 Magenta Fungus Caps to Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath.
rows.quest:2202:details:0: I've heard about a newly discovered plant called the magenta fungus caps. They grow in clusters at the Uldaman dig site and can be found in the early tunnels and deep within the less-explored areas. I want to study their potential use in alchemy, and that's where you come in.
rows.quest:2202:details:1: BFind the magenta cap clusters and bring me a dozen caps. Be warned, the clusters may spew out poison spores if jostled.
rows.quest:2202:details:2: BDo this for me, and I'll whip up a batch of one of my famous restorative elixirs for you!
rows.quest:2202:completion:0: Well done ⟦22⟧, you've proven your worth once again! The caps will be an interesting study, you betcha.
rows.quest:2202:completion:1: BAnd now, as promised, enjoy a taste of one of my more potent restorative brews from my personal stock...
rows.quest:2202:completion:2: BIf you are a skilled alchemist, then perhaps we might have some additional business to conduct. Regardless, I thank you for your assistance!
rows.quest:2204:obj:0: Obtain a power source from the most powerful construct you can find in Uldaman, and deliver it to Talvash del Kissel in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:2204:details:0: You are going to need to find some "oomph" for the necklace, and Uldaman is probably the best place for it, actually. I guess there are a lot of constructs running around in there, yeah? Well, take out the biggest, baddest construct in that place and grab its power source! I am pretty sure I can fuse that source into the necklace.
rows.quest:2204:details:1: BWithout that power source, fixing the necklace will be impossible. Come back to me here to ⟦E3⟧ when you have it, and we'll get it all fixed up for you!
rows.quest:2204:completion:0: Well I'll be - I sure am glad to see you and this power source in one piece. It will take me a moment to magically fuse the power source with the necklace now that the gems have been reunited with it. Once it is done, however, the necklace will be yours!
rows.quest:2204:completion:1: BYou're excited, aren't you? All tingly with anticipation? Now where did I put that spell focus at...
rows.quest:2240:obj:0: Read Baelog's Journal, explore the hidden chamber, then report to Prospector Stormpike.
rows.quest:2240:details:0: Now for the task at hand.
rows.quest:2240:details:1: BThere is a secret chamber, the Chamber of Khaz'mul, that must be explored. The problem is that the chamber's behind a huge, locked door! It's a lucky thing I know how to open it.
rows.quest:2240:details:2: BI've described everything in my journal, here on the table. My band and I are stuck here for now... so you, ⟦23⟧, must find the chamber of Khaz'mul for us!
rows.quest:2240:details:3: BRead my journal, explore the chamber, then report to Prospector Stormpike at the Explorers' League in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:2240:completion:0: You have seen the Chamber of Khaz'mul? Amazing! Baelog was sure it existed, but I must admit that I had my doubts.
rows.quest:2240:completion:1: BThank you, ⟦24⟧. With luck your finding will incite our leaders to renew their efforts to retake Uldaman. And if it is ever again under ⟦E3⟧ control, then the secrets of the Chamber of Khaz'mul will be ours!
rows.quest:2278:obj:0: Speak with stone watcher and learn what ancient lore it keeps. Once you have learned what lore it has to offer, activate the Discs of Norgannon.
rows.quest:2278:details:0: The centerpieces of this treasure chamber are four huge platinum discs, each adorned with numerous sigils of an unknown origin. Touching them makes your hand tingle. Just after touching the discs, the visage of a large stone watcher springs forth.
rows.quest:2278:details:1: B"Salutations. I am a keeper of knowledge. The Creators' synthesis of the Earthen has been chronicled and stored here for this world in the Discs of Norgannon."
rows.quest:2278:details:2: BYou have uncovered a wealth of previously undiscovered worldly lore!
rows.quest:2278:completion:0: Following the instructions of the stone watcher, you once again access the Discs of Norgannon now that you have learned about the history of the Earthen, the troggs, and the dwarves. A faint, brief hum is heard from within the discs. The stone watcher then speaks:
rows.quest:2278:completion:1: B"The discs have now been synthesized. Access the Discs of Norgannon once more to receive your personal copy."
rows.quest:2279:obj:0: Take the miniature version of the Discs of Norgannon to the Explorers' League in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:2279:details:0: Touching the Discs of Norgannon once again makes your hand tingle. This time, however, a strange grinding noise is heard from inside the discs.
rows.quest:2279:details:1: BYour backpack suddenly becomes heavier than it was before. Inside, you discover a miniature version of the discs!
rows.quest:2279:details:2: BNo doubt, an item of this sort would be invaluable for someone interested in the ancient history of ⟦E6⟧. The Explorers' League in ⟦E3⟧ is such a group, known throughout the ⟦E5⟧; perhaps they can make good use of it.
rows.quest:2279:completion:0: What do you have there... oh my. You found this where?
rows.quest:2279:completion:2: BYou spoke to whom about what?
rows.quest:2279:completion:4: BMy fine ⟦25⟧, you may have just made the archaeological find of the year! By the Gods who am I kidding, the find of the century! If these discs are what I think them to be, then this could be the very key we have been looking for! This may well prove outright once and for all the legitimacy of the Dwarves' enchanted creation!
rows.quest:2280:obj:0: Take the miniature version of the Discs of Norgannon to the one of the sages in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:2280:details:0: Touching the Discs of Norgannon once again makes your hand tingle. This time, however, a strange grinding noise is heard from inside the discs.
rows.quest:2280:details:1: BYour backpack suddenly becomes heavier than it was before. Inside, you discover a miniature version of the discs!
rows.quest:2280:details:2: BNo doubt, an item of this sort would be invaluable for someone interested in the ancient history of ⟦E6⟧. The sages of ⟦E7⟧ are such historians, known throughout the ⟦E8⟧; perhaps they can make good use of it.
rows.quest:2280:completion:1: BImpressive, young one! These discs, in them I sense secrets that the earth has held on to tightly for many years. You were very wise to bring them here to me.
rows.quest:2283:obj:0: Look for a valuable necklace within the Uldaman dig site and bring it back to Dran Droffers in ⟦E9⟧. The necklace may be damaged.
rows.quest:2283:details:0: We've got work for you, that is if you've got the guts to do it!
rows.quest:2283:details:1: BDeep in the ⟦E4⟧ is the Uldaman dig site. We've heard a tale about some idiot paladin who died there recently. Why we even care is that he had a very valuable necklace on him. It's supposedly got three large gems: a ruby, a sapphire, and a topaz.
rows.quest:2283:details:2: BThe shot: we want it, and we're payin' TOP SILVER to get it. It may be damaged, but that's neither here nor there; we'll fix whatever scratches are on it.
rows.quest:2283:completion:0: Mmmm salvage! I can smell the necklace from here. Now let's look at that beauty...
rows.quest:2283:completion:1: BHey, what do you think you're trying to do here? This necklace is missing the gems! You think we wouldn't notice? Even Malton could see that the gems are gone.
rows.quest:2283:completion:2: BWell, maybe you didn't steal them... but this necklace is worthless without those gems! Your job isn't done here yet, not by a long shot!
rows.quest:2284:obj:0: Find a clue as to the gems' whereabouts in the depths of Uldaman.
rows.quest:2284:details:0: As sure as Malton is a dummy, those gems are still in Uldaman somewhere. You're going to have to go back there and look for them.
rows.quest:2284:details:1: BLike I said before, if the information we have is correct then there's a ruby, a sapphire, and a topaz that go with the necklace. Find them and put them in the necklace.
rows.quest:2284:details:2: BAs to where the gems are, who knows? Maybe you'll get lucky and find the corpse of the Paladin. If he's not been stripped clean already, then maybe he's got them on him still.
rows.quest:2284:completion:0: You seem to have found the remains of the paladin that Dran had mentioned from before. Searching the remains uncovers what would appear to be his journal. The book is in poor condition, as dried blood has stained most of the text in the book. What you can read, however, is gibberish; it is written in the native tongue of the humans, to the best of your knowledge.
rows.quest:2284:completion:1: BYou will need the book translated if you are to glean any knowledge from it.
rows.quest:2318:obj:0: Find someone who can translate the paladin's journal. The closest location that might have someone is Kargath, in the ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:2318:details:0: At an impasse of sorts, you know that you will need the book translated into a language you can understand. There certainly are a number of people in the world who could do it; the closest location that might have someone who could, however, is the Kargath outpost in the ⟦E4⟧. Perhaps that is a good place to start.⟦26⟧
rows.quest:2318:completion:0: Mighty ⟦27⟧, I know what you are doing out here in the ⟦E4⟧. I know you seek my gift of tongues. You're after the parts to that necklace you found in Uldaman.
rows.quest:2318:completion:1: BSurprised? Don't be - it's my job to know such things. Instead, let's discuss what you're going to do for a translated journal. Trust me - I'm the only one you'll find that can translate it.
rows.quest:2318:completion:2: BBetter still, let me make you a better offer than Dran Droffers is, and it'll let you still complete your deal with them. Interested now, yes?
rows.quest:2338:obj:0: Let Jarkal borrow the necklace. In exchange, he will translate the journal for you.
rows.quest:2338:details:0: Droffers and Son Salvage aren't smart enough to restore the magic in the necklace, but I am. All I want to do is study the necklace so I can learn to make them myself. To do that, I will need your necklace. Let me borrow it, and in exchange for the time I get to study it I will translate the journal for you. While you are searching for the gems, I should have enough time to learn what I need to.
rows.quest:2338:details:1: BIt's a simple deal, and no one else will be the wiser. Whatcha wanna do?
rows.quest:2338:completion:0: You know a good deal when you see one - I knew I could count on you.
rows.quest:2338:completion:1: BIt will be just a moment while I cast a spell to quickly translate the human tongue into a form you will understand. I am a troll of my word; ask anyone in the ⟦E8⟧ about Jarkal Mossmeld. Now, let's get this started...
rows.quest:2339:obj:0: Recover all three gems and a power source for the necklace from Uldaman, and then bring them to Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath. Jarkal believes a power source might be found on the strongest construct present in Uldaman.
rows.quest:2339:obj:1: BFrom the journal, you know...⟦28⟧* The ruby has been stashed in a barricaded Shadowforge area.⟦29⟧* The topaz has been hidden in an urn in one of the Trogg areas, near some ⟦E5⟧ dwarves.⟦30⟧* The sapphire has been claimed by Grimlok, the trogg leader.
rows.quest:2339:details:0: Here is the journal, translated for you to read on your own. The crux of it says dwarves hid the ruby, the troggs hid the topaz, and a trogg named Grimlok has the sapphire.
rows.quest:2339:details:1: BLook - you're going to need a power source to make the necklace work again. Dran Droffers doesn't know this. To find one, here's what I'd do: go as deep as you can in Uldaman and kill whatever construct there is the strongest. No doubt whatever that is would have it.
rows.quest:2339:details:2: BWhen you have everything collected, come back here!
rows.quest:2339:completion:0: Very well done, ⟦31⟧. Now the fruits of our redirection will pay themselves out handsomely. I'm finished with the necklace itself, and I am confident I can duplicate the construction process consistently.
rows.quest:2339:completion:1: BBut first, I will use a specially prepared incantation to quickly analyze those gems before you take them and the necklace back to ⟦E9⟧. This will take just a brief moment to do.
rows.quest:2340:obj:0: Deliver the Necklace and Gem Salvage to Dran Droffers in ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:2340:details:0: Any necklace setting and gem will work, so long as they are the same material. This power source, however, is what will bring the magic back to the necklace... I hope.
rows.quest:2340:details:1: BI'll gladly supply the gems needed for your version of the necklace, so long as the power source actually works.
rows.quest:2340:details:2: BHead to ⟦E9⟧ and keep your end of the bargain with Droffers and Son Salvage. Just keep your mouth shut about our deal, and when you get back I might have a wonderful surprise for you.
rows.quest:2340:completion:0: Yep, it's all here. Say, mind if we keep the bag too? No? Thanks, appreciate it! Har!
rows.quest:2340:completion:1: BThis necklace will be our greatest haul yet! Don't feel too bad though; I'm sure the necklace wouldn't fit you anyway. Har again!
rows.quest:2340:completion:2: BA deal is a deal, so here's your fee for the salvage. Our business is done here for now; check back later to see if we have more work. Until then, beat it!
rows.quest:2341:obj:0: Visit Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath to see if he was successful.
rows.quest:2341:details:0: As Dran and Malton Droffers begin to squabble over their new salvage, half of the deal is now complete. A trip to the ⟦E4⟧ is now in order to finish things up, as Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath might have a special reward waiting for you there.
rows.quest:2341:completion:0: The power source you gave me exceeded every expectation I had for it. I was able to make both you and me a necklace, and I have enough left over to make at least three more. They will fetch quite the fee, with Droffers and Son Salvage none the wiser.
rows.quest:2341:completion:1: BHere you go, my friend. I give you my thanks on a splendid job... and something quite special for your trouble.
rows.quest:2342:obj:0: Get Patrick Garrett's family treasure from their family chest in the South Common Hall of Uldaman, and bring it to him in the ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:2342:details:0: Sweeping the bat pens with this broom is not befitting a Garrett! I've earned a little coin from this accursed job, and I'm willing to spend it on you to better my station.
rows.quest:2342:details:1: BThe Garrett family weapon of choice is locked away in our chest in the South Common Hall of Uldaman from when we Garretts toiled there as diggers. Without it, I will be stuck here forever - literally - sweeping up after these infernal bats.
rows.quest:2342:details:2: BReclaim my family's treasure and bring it to me! Help me restore my birthright!
rows.quest:2342:completion:0: At last - a broom worthy of a Garrett. You're bloody well worth every silver I spent on you, I say!
rows.quest:2342:completion:1: BDo you hear me, foul bats? I now wield the Garrett family weapon of choice! Tremble, bats, tremble!!
rows.quest:2361:completion:0: I gladly give you this necklace, mighty ⟦32⟧. You have done me an invaluable service, and for that I thank you. Wear it with pride, and make sure you mention loudly and repeatedly who made it for you!
rows.quest:2361:completion:1: BAlso, if you could toss in the fact that it really isn't cursed, that would be great.
rows.quest:2398:details:0: The dig site at Uldaman wasn't always overrun. We ⟦E3⟧ dwarves used to control the area, but... that was before the troggs came. They came so fast and in such numbers that not even dwarven might could stop them!
rows.quest:2398:details:1: BIn fact, their attack was so sudden that I fear some of our people may be trapped behind enemy lines.
rows.quest:2398:details:2: BMy friend Baelog led a small band of dwarves deep within the site just before the troggs showed up. If he and his company live, then I want you to find them.
rows.quest:2398:completion:0: It's about time you showed up! I was in danger of losing a bet with Olaf!
rows.quest:2398:completion:1: BHe wagered that his beard would grow to his knees before he saw another living ⟦33⟧. Well here you are, and as you can see Olaf's beard has a few more inches to go.
rows.quest:2398:completion:2: BThanks, ⟦34⟧. I'll split the winnings with you.
rows.quest:2418:obj:0: Bring 8 Dentrium Power Stones and 8 An'Alleum Power Stones to Rigglefuzz in the ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:2418:details:0: A while ago, I had an incident with the Shadowforge Dwarves. They brought me to Angor Fortress to study two types of strange stones from Uldaman. I discovered that the stones were sustained, stable power sources if treated correctly. It's amazing the things one can find in that old dig site!
rows.quest:2418:details:1: BAnyway, after I told them the secret of the stones they kicked me out of Angor Fortress and began digging for more in Uldaman.
rows.quest:2418:details:2: BI want those stones for myself! Bring me both types and I'll pay you plenty!
rows.quest:2418:completion:0: That's great, you found some! Thanks a lot, ⟦35⟧. You're the most dependable ⟦36⟧ I've met!
rows.quest:2418:completion:1: BI can't wait to try these on some devices I've been tinkering with. I bet that, under the right circumstances, devices powered with these stones will keep going, and going, and going...
